title: How this draft was checked
body: drafter wrote the page from the blueprint you approved in batch 3. A fresh fact-checker read 160 claims against the code: 148 held, 10 were imprecise, and 2 were unsupported. The register editor's 30 findings, 2 of them blocking, were applied. Two rechecks of the changed lines followed: 68 of 75 held, then 15 of 16. Each finding is fixed, and the last fix is in the fact store.
Every claim fix was carried back to the blueprint line that places it, so the blueprint and the page agree.

title: The twin route wins by route order, not a sorting rule
body: The draft said SvelteKit's sorting rules prefer the more specific matched route. In SvelteKit 3.0.1, `sort.js:101-102` returns before the matcher check when it compares two bare rest parameters. `[...path=md]` comes first because routes are read in name order (`create_manifest_data/index.js:221-223`), and the `md` matcher passes only `.md` paths. The page now states the outcome alone, and `f:03lbjg` dropped the reason.
was: SvelteKit's route sorting rules prefer the more specific matched route, so `[...path=md]` takes the `.md` paths and `[...path]` keeps the rest.
now: With both routes in place, `[...path=md]` takes the `.md` paths and `[...path]` keeps the rest.

title: The noindex helper now covers every concept
body: The draft's helper looked entries up with `posts.byId`, but the scaffold's sitemap rows come from `site.all()`. A `noindex` page in another concept would have slipped into the sitemap. The helper now takes a `ContentSummary` and looks it up with `site.byPermalink`.

title: The glob failure names only the proven cases
body: gray-matter throws `expected input to be a string or buffer` for a non-string input (`gray-matter/lib/utils.js:46`), which a lazy glob or a missing `import: 'default'` hands it. Without `?raw`, Vite imports the `.md` as a module first, and what follows depends on the site's plugins, so the page no longer claims that case. `f:n07oiu` and Define an adapter and schema get the same narrowing in this batch.

title: The share steps name where the group sits
body: The steps split so each holds one action, and they now say the **Share preview** group is in the entry's **Details** slide-over (`EditPage.svelte:2383-2441`). The blueprint and `f:sp1mbt` changed to match.

title: The head example uses a contact page
body: The draft's example added an `(site)/about` route. A scaffolded site already has an `about` pages entry, so the static route would collide with the catch-all's entry and fail SvelteKit's prerender check. The example now uses a contact page, which the scaffold doesn't have, and the sitemap example's extra route changed to `/contact` with it.

title: Keep the wrangler dev measurement?
body: The note says a local `wrangler dev` test served the twin as `text/markdown`, which suggests Cloudflare derives the type from the extension, and that no deployed zone has been tested.
